Thanks for the ping, Laura — copying People Ops & Legal to confirm the baseline and next steps. Drafting an exit checklist and severance template now; attaching a working draft (see attachments). High-level proposal for voluntary resignations at IC level:

- Garden leave: discretionary, usually 2 weeks paid if individual requests and it serves a coverage purpose; must be approved by manager + People Ops.
- Severance: not standard for voluntary resignations unless there are extenuating circumstances; can be offered on a case-by-case basis (board/HR approval).
- Equity: standard practice is no acceleration for voluntary resignations; exceptions require Legal and Compensation sign-off.
- PTO: payout per policy in final paycheck; confirm local payroll timing.
- Access: we typically schedule access revocation on the last working day unless garden leave is enforced earlier (in that case, revoke at start of garden-leave).

Action items I propose:
1) Monica: prepare a minimal severance offer draft in case we agree to offer 2 weeks pay + standard continuation of healthcare for the payout period (attachment: 20260602-severance-draft.pdf).
2) Markus: confirm non-compete enforceability note and whether we should request a signed resignation acknowledgement (see equity doc attached).
3) Laura: confirm whether you want to propose garden leave (yes/no) and list 3 high-priority handover items.
4) Karthik: please confirm if you prefer a garden leave window or remain fully active through June 18.

I'll also schedule a 30-min touch with Karthik and Laura to review the handover calendar tomorrow 09:30-10:00 PT (inv sent).

People Partner, Redwood Inference

Quick note from Legal after a brief review:

- Non-compete: Karhtik's employment agreement includes a standard non-compete and confidentiality clause. Enforceability varies by state — if we plan to seek enforcement we should consult external counsel (cc'd Jane). For routine resignations we do not initiate enforcement; instead, we remind the employee of ongoing obligations and confirm return of property.
- Equity: No legal requirement to accelerate unvested RSUs on voluntary resignations. Any deviation exposes us to precedent risk; if Compensation wants to approve an exception, document the rationale in writing.
- Signed resignation acknowledgement: recommended. Simple statement acknowledging last day and listing outstanding obligations (device return, IP assignment reminder). I can draft language.

Suggested wording snippet to include in the resignation acknowledgement (short):
"We acknowledge receipt of your resignation and confirm that your last date of employment will be [date]. You remain bound by the terms of your Employee Agreement with respect to confidentiality, assignment of inventions, and any restrictive covenants. Please return company property by your last date of employment."

I'll draft the acknowledgement and circulate for sign-off. If Compensation or Execs want to pursue a garden leave or pay supplement, notify me and I'll prepare the agreement addendum.

-Markus
General Counsel
